# StopPaging

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders as much of its child as fits on the current page and discards the rest, instead of continuing onto further pages.

This is the truncation primitive: a preview that must stay one page long, an appendix capped at whatever the remaining space allows, a summary panel that should never grow the document. Unlike [`ShowEntire`](show-entire.md) it does not move to a fresh page first - it starts exactly where the cursor is and stops at the page boundary.

Truncation is silent by design: the child is asked to render, and its continuation is simply never requested.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `PaginationWrapperBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new StopPaging()
new StopPaging(options: StopPagingOptions)
new StopPaging(child: IElement)
```
